components.name: Bottom navigation
components.description: The one bottom navigation for mobile and tablet: a Dual capsule on the leading side and a Solo round capsule on the trailing side. Variant: Mobile (390×104, side inset 24) or Tablet (834×104, side inset 64). Top 16 / bottom 24 leave room for the home indicator. Transparent — sits over content. React: <BottomNavigation device="tablet" />

components.name: Bottom nav group
components.description: Capsule inside Bottom navigation. Variant: Dual (two labelled items, 240×64) or Solo (one icon-only item, 64×64). surface/raised + Elevation/3 Floating, radius/full, padding 4, no border. Nested items are exposed.

components.name: Bottom nav item
components.description: One destination of Bottom navigation. Variant: Label (Solid icon 24 + label, 116×56) or Icon only (56×56). State: Default · Selected (accent/soft background, text/accent) · Focus. Swap Icon (BEK - Icons, Solid) and set Label.

Do / Don’t
Do
Two labelled destinations in Dual + one icon-only destination in Solo. Solid icons; one-word labels; same order on every screen.
Don’t
Don’t add a third item to Dual or a label to Solo, and don’t use Stroke icons for the selected item.
